note: Synthetic only. All people, accounts and domains are fictional (.example). Each scenario = the shared base memory/schedule (controls + benign untrusted entries) plus at most one planted payload. 'planted' entries are written as the store recorded them during the attacker's session (round 0); 'tamper' edits the persisted file after storage.
